entries.name: 河童・きゅうりどうぞ
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE photorealistic full-body transparent cutout of elderly Japanese Kozo as a playful Japanese YOKAI for a commemorative photo compositing app. Reference image 1 is the IDENTITY reference: keep his recognizable smiling wrinkled elderly male face, gray hair, thin glasses and age. Replace the fishing cap and original polo outfit completely. The result is the SAME elderly Japanese man transformed by a fanciful theatrical yokai outfit, not a child, young model or unrelated face. Facial expression remains warm, mischievous and approachable. Real wearable textiles, fur, sculpted stage materials and carefully crafted creature details, neutral soft photographic light. No readable text, logos or branded modern fictional character design. No gore, wounds or blood. ONE person, no secondary creatures or humans. Human arms and hands remain coherent with five fingers where visible; any extra appendages specified are obviously attached costume structures. ENTIRE head, headdress, body, feet and ALL tails, wings, garment ends and props must fit fully inside a portrait canvas. Compose figure at about 84 percent of canvas height, with at least 80px genuinely transparent padding above and below and 50px at sides. Nothing cropped. Full-body front three-quarter view with a clear readable silhouette. Actual ALPHA TRANSPARENT background, including open spaces around limbs and props; NO scenery, studio backdrop, floor plane, gradient, checkerboard, colored fog, halo or glow. Preserve the complete recognizable Kozo face except the explicit small theatrical details specified, never obscure it behind a full mask.
Yokai costume and pose: Fresh GREEN kappa costume: small round shallow water-dish cap centered on gray hair, leafy side fringe, dark green turtle shell strapped to back and clearly visible beside shoulders, moss-green short kimono jacket and pants, webbed green foot covers. No beak covering human face. Offering ONE cucumber forward in one hand, other hand giving a gentle thumbs-up. Playful smooth green fabric, not a generic turtle mascot.
